svg.aria-label: dsh-translate: two independent faces - the /translate rosetta lookup and the tools/post-execute JSON repair state machine
svg.title: dsh-translate structure: parameter rosetta + deterministic JSON repair
svg.desc: Lane A: /translate reads the 13-parameter by 11-vendor rosetta table and returns a pair mapping. Lane B: tools/post-execute and fix_json extract a fence, parse, run a bounded strategy loop (escapeRepair, trailingComma, truncationClosure), complete required fields with null, validate against the supported schema subset, then accept a repaired value or call next() and keep the original.
svg.text: index.mjs · inject: commands + tools · pure host
no network · no model call · no build step
pure lookup · zero model calls · transformRequest() converts a whole standard request
no invented data · null is a placeholder
accept is re-validated · next() keeps the original
